model_annotation: The plot compares the Loss across the number of iterations for six different models: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The linear x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", ranging from 0 to approximately 145000, with tick labels at intervals of 20000.  The linear y-axis, labeled "Loss", spans from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick marks spaced every 0.1 units. All models are represented by solid lines lacking distinctive marker shapes and feature a faintly shaded surrounding band indicating variance along their trajectory. Every line demonstrates a sharp initial decline from an off-axis starting value above 3.4 near iteration 0, followed by a continuous, gradual decrease for the remainder of the chart. The light blue line representing StrmLLM (n=64) falls to roughly 2.82 by 20000 iterations and steadily descends to a final value near 2.61 around 145000 iterations. The orange line for SepLLM (n=64) drops to roughly 2.71 at 20000 iterations and ends near 2.53. The dark blue line for the Vanilla model decreases to roughly 2.69 by 20000 iterations and decays to approximately 2.51. The green line, representing SepLLM (n=64, H), falls to 2.68 at 20000 iterations and ends near 2.50. The red line for SepLLM (n=64, H/T) drops to 2.64 at 20000 iterations, concluding at an approximate value of 2.49. Finally, the purple line representing SepLLM (n=128) follows the lowest path, decreasing to approximately 2.62 at 20000 iterations and ending at roughly 2.46.
